name: mature T cell proliferation 1

function.text: MTCP1 encodes protein p13 MTCP-1. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine kinase activator activity and protein kinase binding. It participates in intracellular signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
